description: One-glance health of the whole install. Each tile is the worst state of its area: green OK, yellow warning, red critical, grey NO DATA (the source is missing, which is never shown as healthy). Click a tile for the detailed dashboard.

panels.title: Hypervisors
panels.description: CRITICAL: no hypervisor Online, or any hypervisor in Error. WARNING: a hypervisor is degraded, or its stats exporter cannot read libvirt. Plus any firing alert with area=hypervisors.

targets.expr:
max(
  label_replace(max(2 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="hypervisors",severity="critical"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="hypervisors",severity="warning"} or 0 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="hypervisors"}), "k", "s0", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * ((count(isardvdi_isardvdi_api_hypervisor_info{status="Online"}) or on() (0 * count(isardvdi_isardvdi_api_hypervisor_info))) == bool 0), "k", "s1", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * ((count(isardvdi_isardvdi_api_hypervisor_info{status="Error"}) or on() (0 * count(isardvdi_isardvdi_api_hypervisor_info))) > bool 0), "k", "s2", "", "")
  or label_replace(min(isardvdi_hypervisor_scrape_duration_success) == bool 0, "k", "s3", "", "")
  or label_replace(max(isardvdi_isardvdi_api_hypervisor_degraded), "k", "s4", "", "")
)

panels.title: Storage & NFS
panels.description: Filesystems under /opt/isard (local or NFS) over 90% (WARNING) / 95% (CRITICAL) on any host, plus alerts with area=storage (storage workers, PSI).

targets.expr:
max(
  label_replace(max(2 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="storage",severity="critical"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="storage",severity="warning"} or 0 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="storage"}), "k", "s0", "", "")
  or label_replace(max(((1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint=~"/opt/isard(/.*)?",fstype!~"tmpfs|rootfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint=~"/opt/isard(/.*)?",fstype!~"tmpfs|rootfs"}) > bool 0.90) + ((1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint=~"/opt/isard(/.*)?",fstype!~"tmpfs|rootfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint=~"/opt/isard(/.*)?",fstype!~"tmpfs|rootfs"}) > bool 0.95)), "k", "s1", "", "")
  or label_replace(0 * isardvdi_storage_governor:worker_up:sum, "k", "s2", "", "")
)

panels.title: Queues / Governor
panels.description: Storage-governor vmalert rules with area=queues (backlog, SLA age, task streams, exporter). CRITICAL when the governor scrape fails.

targets.expr:
max(
  label_replace(max(2 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="queues",severity="critical"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="queues",severity="warning"} or 0 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="queues"}), "k", "s0", "", "")
  or label_replace(0 * max(isardvdi_storage_governor_scrape_duration_seconds), "k", "s1", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * (min(isardvdi_storage_governor_scrape_duration_success) == bool 0), "k", "s2", "", "")
)

panels.title: Redis
panels.description: CRITICAL: broker down. WARNING: used memory over 90% of maxmemory. Plus alerts with area=redis (evictions).

targets.expr:
max(
  label_replace(max(2 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="redis",severity="critical"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="redis",severity="warning"} or 0 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="redis"}), "k", "s0", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * (min(isardvdi_storage_governor_redis_up) == bool 0), "k", "s1", "", "")
  or label_replace(max(isardvdi_storage_governor_redis_used_memory_ratio) > bool 0.9, "k", "s2", "", "")
)

panels.title: RethinkDB
panels.description: CRITICAL: haproxy's isard-db health check is DOWN. NO DATA when the exporter is not reporting. No rule yet for slow queries.

targets.expr:
max(
  label_replace(max(2 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="rethinkdb",severity="critical"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="rethinkdb",severity="warning"} or 0 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="rethinkdb"}), "k", "s0", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * max(min by (proxy) (haproxy_backend_status{proxy=~"be_isard-db",state="DOWN"})), "k", "s1", "", "")
  or label_replace(0 * max(rethinkdb_cluster_client_connections), "k", "s2", "", "")
)

panels.title: Web / API
panels.description: CRITICAL: a core backend (apiv4, authentication, static, webapp, socketio, scheduler) is DOWN in haproxy, stats cannot query the API, or over 5% of HTTPS responses are 5xx (5m). WARNING: over 1% 5xx.

targets.expr:
max(
  label_replace(max(2 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="web",severity="critical"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="web",severity="warning"} or 0 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="web"}), "k", "s0", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * max(min by (proxy) (haproxy_backend_status{proxy=~"be_isard-(apiv4|authentication|static|webapp|socketio|scheduler)",state="DOWN"})), "k", "s1", "", "")
  or label_replace(((sum(rate(haproxy_frontend_http_responses_total{proxy="fe_http_secured",code="5xx"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(haproxy_frontend_http_responses_total{proxy="fe_http_secured"}[5m])), 1)) > bool 0.01) + ((sum(rate(haproxy_frontend_http_responses_total{proxy="fe_http_secured",code="5xx"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(haproxy_frontend_http_responses_total{proxy="fe_http_secured"}[5m])), 1)) > bool 0.05), "k", "s2", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * (min(isardvdi_isardvdi_api_scrape_duration_success) == bool 0), "k", "s3", "", "")
)

panels.title: Viewers
panels.description: CRITICAL: the SPICE/VNC proxies (websockify, squid) are DOWN in haproxy. WARNING: the RDP gateways (guacamole, rdpgw) are DOWN, or the viewer socket collector fails.

targets.expr:
max(
  label_replace(max(2 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="viewers",severity="critical"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="viewers",severity="warning"} or 0 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="viewers"}), "k", "s0", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * max(min by (proxy) (haproxy_backend_status{proxy=~"be_isard-(websockify|squid)",state="DOWN"})), "k", "s1", "", "")
  or label_replace(max(min by (proxy) (haproxy_backend_status{proxy=~"be_isard-(guacamole|rdpgw)",state="DOWN"})), "k", "s2", "", "")
  or label_replace(min(isardvdi_socket_scrape_duration_success) == bool 0, "k", "s3", "", "")
)

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: Every host running grafana-alloy: available memory under 10% (WARNING) / 5% (CRITICAL), root filesystem over 90% / 95%.

targets.expr:
max(
  label_replace(max(2 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="hosts",severity="critical"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="hosts",severity="warning"} or 0 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="hosts"}), "k", "s0", "", "")
  or label_replace(max(((node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) < bool 0.10) + ((node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) < bool 0.05)), "k", "s1", "", "")
  or label_replace(max(((1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!="rootfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!="rootfs"}) > bool 0.90) + ((1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!="rootfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!="rootfs"}) > bool 0.95)), "k", "s2", "", "")
)

panels.title: Monitoring
panels.description: WARNING: a scrape target is down. Plus alerts with area=monitoring (telemetry not reaching the monitor, logs discarded, rule errors). NO DATA when vmalert is not evaluating.

targets.expr:
max(
  label_replace(max(2 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="monitoring",severity="critical"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="monitoring",severity="warning"} or 0 * ALERTS{alertstate="firing",area="monitoring"}), "k", "s0", "", "")
  or label_replace(max(up == bool 0), "k", "s1", "", "")
  or label_replace(0 * max(isardvdi:vmalert_heartbeat), "k", "s2", "", "")
)

panels.title: Backups
panels.description: Only alerts with area=backups. No backup metric is exported yet, so this tile reads NO DATA until a rule exists — never green by default.

panels.title: Certificates
panels.description: Only alerts with area=certificates. No certificate-expiry metric is exported yet, so this tile reads NO DATA until a rule exists.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Every vmalert rule firing now, any area. Shows NO DATA when vmalert is not evaluating (its heartbeat series is absent), so an empty list is never mistaken for a healthy one.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Every vmalert rule firing now. Since = when it went active (blank when vmalert did not record it). The summary and runbook text of each rule are in Alerting > Alert rules (data source-managed). Use the area selector at the top to filter.

panels.title: Last data received
panels.description: Age of the newest sample of each source, on its stalest host. Over 2 minutes is WARNING, over 10 minutes CRITICAL. A source silent for more than an hour shows NO DATA: a missing source is never green.

title: System Health
